title: OSMF Research Tracker: open evidence on candidate therapeutics, biomarkers and clinical trials for post-viral and chronic conditions
description:
Daily-updated, open-access research tracker maintained by the Open Source Medicine Foundation. It compiles peer-reviewed studies (PubMed), registered clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov), therapeutic-agent evidence, biomarker atlases and post-acute infection syndrome (PAIS) cohort data for Long COVID, PACVS, ME/CFS, Lyme disease, Gulf War Illness and 50+ chronic conditions, with druggable gene targets and candidate repurposed compounds graded by evidence from DGIdb, Open Targets and ChEMBL.

Live site: research.opensourcemed.info. Research information, not medical advice.
